one_month_reasoning: The last in-window close is Fri 2026-10-30. EDGAR shows past Q3 prints on Nov 2-7 (2022-11-07, 2023-11-02, 2024-11-04, 2025-11-05) and no date 8-K yet (source 32), so Q3 results almost certainly fall just after the window. In the window: routine officer 10b5-1 Form 4/144 sales (sources 32, 4), hyperscaler capex prints in late October, and neocloud sentiment (CRWV/NBIS), which has driven 7-9% days without DOCN news (sources 2, 3). Pre-announcement risk is small; past ones (July 2026) came with capital-markets actions. With no scheduled DOCN catalyst I stay near symmetric around spot with a tiny negative log-drift (-0.8%) and monthly sigma 22.5% (slightly below 82%/3.5 because realized vol includes +18%/+40% earnings days): P(>=140.07)=0.49.

fair_value.method: Horizon (Oct-2027) value on NTM = CY2028: EV/EBITDA 14.2x (11-peer CY27 median, no premium) x $0.96B EBITDA less $1.1B net debt over 125M shares = $100 (65%); P/E 35x x CY28 street-basis EPS $2.30 = $81 (35%); blend ~$94.

FY26 guide 38.5-39.5%; CY27 consensus 40% ($730M/$1.81B); held at the low end because GM fell 59.9%->55.0% y/y and $2.76B of uncommenced leases start hitting cost before revenue. Consensus CY28 $1.11B (41%) is the upside sensitivity: it gives ~$117/share at the same multiple.

Median of 11 peers on CY2027 MarketScreener consensus EV/EBITDA (MSFT and ORCL calendarized): 14.2x, range 7.5x-128x; 9-name infrastructure subset 13.7x. No premium: DOCN's CY28 EBITDA growth (~32%) is near the peer growth middle, and the faster-growing capital-intensive peers (CRWV +55% revenue 7.5x, ORCL ~+37% EPS 8.7x, NBIS 15x) trade at or below the median, so growth funded with leases does not earn a persistent premium in this market. A discount is not imposed because the legacy CPU/SMB cloud is profitable and sticky.

Peer CY27 street P/E median 23.7x over the 9 profitable peers (infrastructure-only 23.4x), range 14.1x-210x. 35x (inside the range, ~48% premium) because DOCN's EPS growth (~28%) is about twice the infrastructure P/E peers' (AKAM ~8%, AMZN/GOOGL/MSFT ~10-15%) and is partly contracted ($894M RPO, $366M within 12 months; >50% 2027 growth guide). The premium stays well below growth parity (PEG parity would be ~45-50x) because EPS quality is deteriorating: gross margin down 5pts, D&A +56%, rising SBC and lease costs.

bear.story: 2027 growth lands in the 30s not >50% as one or two nine-figure AI customers slip or renegotiate, while $2.76B of leases and MUFG-financed GPUs hit costs first; NTM EBITDA ~$0.85B, market applies a neocloud-like ~11x and net debt rises to ~$1.3B -> ~$64-70, near the $77 March offering price.

base.story: >50% 2027 growth delivered, CY28 EBITDA ~$0.96B; the multiple compresses from 22.9x CY27 today about halfway toward the 14x peer median (~17x NTM) as the business looks more like capital-intensive infrastructure -> ~$125, modestly below spot.

bull.story: More nine-figure inference contracts, CY28 tracks the $2.69B/$1.11B consensus, and the market keeps an AI-growth multiple (~27x NTM EBITDA) -> ~$230.

comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: DOCN today: ~78x CY27 street EPS ($140.07/$1.80) and ~22.9x CY27 EV/EBITDA (market cap $16.47B + net debt $0.28B over $730M). We apply 14.2x EV/EBITDA (at the median) and 35x P/E (inside the range, above the median) to CY2028 numbers.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: EV/EBITDA: no premium. On EBITDA, DOCN's growth (~32% CY28) is not structurally above the peer set: the fastest-growing capital-intensive peers (CRWV, ORCL, NBIS) are the cheapest, so the market is not paying a persistent premium for lease-funded AI capacity. P/E: a ~48% premium to the 23.7x median, because EPS growth (~28%) is about double the infrastructure peers' and is partly contracted by the $894M RPO through the horizon; it is held well below PEG parity because gross margin, D&A and lease costs are moving against EPS. No sell-side outperformance call is used.

thesis_break_reason: At $85 the EV (~$10.6B equity on 125M shares + $1.1B horizon net debt = ~$11.7B) is ~12x CY28 EBITDA of $0.96B, below the 14.2x peer median and roughly CRWV-like, near the $77 March offering price. That would mean the market no longer believes the >50% 2027 path or a nine-figure AI contract has slipped, or that lease/MUFG funding needs a dilutive raise, rather than ordinary 80% volatility.

reasoning: Skeptic lane, round 2. The supervisor's fact-checks were verified and adopted: no term loan (repaid 3/27/26), $471.8M of 2030 converts repurchased 7/23/26 with the $1.474B direct offering (8-K, source 29), so net debt today is ~$0.28B and ~$1.1B at the horizon, not my $2.2B; 125M diluted shares, not 121M; the March raise was 11.95M shares; consensus CY27 EPS is ~$1.80 street, and my GAAP-basis 61x peer P/E and REIT-inflated 20.3x EV/EBITDA medians were wrong. The '$565M insider selling' claim (TIKR) is dropped: EDGAR shows only routine officer 10b5-1 Form 4/144s, and the 8/6/26 13D/A by Access Industries reports a change in percentage (15.86%, 18.65M shares), i.e. dilution, not a sale (source 31). I differ from the supervisor in reading it: there is no evidence of a large disposition, but the stake itself is an overhang. Finviz still shows insider transactions -15.4% over 6 months and short float 9.0%, up from ~7.4% (source 33). Rebuilt comps on one CY27 basis (11 peers, EQIX/DLR out, MSFT/ORCL in and calendarized): EV/EBITDA median 14.2x, P/E median 23.7x. The two corrections offset: lower net debt adds ~$9/share, the lower multiple removes ~$40. Fair value ~$94 (EV/EBITDA $100, P/E $81), below the supervisor's $112 because I give no EV/EBITDA premium and a smaller P/E premium, and use CY28 revenue of $2.50B instead of consensus $2.69B. The price is not fair value: today's 22.9x CY27 EV/EBITDA regime will not fully compress in 12 months, so the base scenario is $125. Scenarios bear $68 (30%) / base $125 (45%) / bull $230 (25%); mean ~$134, median ~$123. The ladder is a lognormal mixture (sigmas 0.35/0.25/0.30), with the far-left tail lifted to 2% below $35 given DOCN's 85% drawdown in 2021-22. P(>=140)=0.39, below round 1's 0.45. Research was limited to ~8 targeted fetches (EDGAR, MarketScreener MSFT/ORCL, Finviz DOCN/AKAM/CRWV, stockanalysis). Other Finviz peer P/Es are taken from the supervisor's spot-checked set, and I verified AKAM (16.1x vs 15.8x) and CRWV (loss) myself.
